[EN] , I've located the second stone. Please come find me in Highwatch.

- Meren
[ES] , he localizado la segunda piedra. Por favor, ven a buscarme a Highwatch.

- Meren

[EN] Meren discovered the location of the Celestial Stone.
The stone was being held as a prize for the winner of the Celestial Arena.
You won the prize, and further empowered the Eternal Crown.
[ES] Meren descubrió la ubicación de la Celestial Stone.
La piedra se entregaba como premio al ganador de la Celestial Arena.
Ganaste el premio y dotaste de más poder a la Eternal Crown.

[EN] , I was waiting for you.

I've located the second stone.

It's called the Celestial Stone, and it's quite near us.

Have you ever heard of the name Bethania?"No."
[ES] , te estaba esperando.

He localizado la segunda piedra.

Se llama Celestial Stone y está muy cerca de nosotros.

¿Alguna vez has oído el nombre de Bethania?"No."

[EN] She's a legendary entertainer. She's the one who created Bamarama.

She's a born gambler who's always looking for a new game.

She also designed the Celestial Arena.

Speaking of which, there's a tournament to be held at the arena, and wouldn't you know, the Celestial Stone is the prize.

You can find Bethania near the Celestial Arena Manager. To get the stone, you'll have to talk to her.
[ES] Es una artista legendaria. Es quien creó Bamarama.

Es una jugadora nata que siempre está buscando un nuevo juego.

También diseñó la Celestial Arena.

Hablando de eso, se va a celebrar un torneo en la arena y, adivina qué, la Celestial Stone es el premio.

Puedes encontrar a Bethania cerca del Celestial Arena Manager. Para conseguir la piedra, tendrás que hablar con ella.

[EN] Welcome, ! Are you here to participate in the tournament?

You'll be able to show off your skills, and compete for fabulous prizes!

What? Eternal Crown? Celestial Stone? I don't know what you're talking about

What, this? It's just a shiny bauble. It isn't worth anything, I checked!

This is a bit depressing."We need the stone."
[ES] ¡Bienvenido, ! ¿Estás aquí para participar en el torneo?

¡Podrás demostrar tus habilidades y competir por premios fabulosos!

¿Qué? ¿Eternal Crown? ¿Celestial Stone? No sé de qué estás hablando.

¿Qué, esto? Es solo una baratija brillante. ¡No vale nada, lo comprobé!

Esto es un poco deprimente."We need the stone."

[EN] Well, can you at least pretend to work for it? This arena is designed to challenge the best of the best, and you certainly qualify.

By defeating monster after monster, challengers advance to the final stages. Do you see what I'm saying?

The stone is part of the tournament, I can't just give it away.."You know it's for the Goddess, right?"
[ES] Bueno, ¿puedes al menos fingir que te esfuerzas? Esta arena está diseñada para desafiar a lo mejor de lo mejor, y sin duda cumples los requisitos.

Derrotando monstruo tras monstruo, los retadores avanzan a las etapas finales. ¿Entiendes lo que digo?

La piedra es parte del torneo, no puedo simplemente regalarla."You know it's for the Goddess, right?"

[EN] I do now. That should give you more motivation to win and claim the prize!

[Speak with {@linkcreature:183#7001#Gaderong} to enter the Celestial Arena.]
[ES] Ahora sí. ¡Eso debería darte más motivación para ganar y reclamar el premio!

[Speak with {@linkcreature:183#7001#Gaderong} to enter the Celestial Arena.]

[EN] Looks like all the contestants are here.

For those who are ready, go speak with Gaderong.
[ES] Parece que todos los participantes están aquí.

Los que estén listos, vayan a hablar con Gaderong.

[EN] Well done. That was something indeed.

"I won, right?"
[ES] Bien hecho. Eso sí que ha sido algo increíble.

"I won, right?"

[EN] Of course you did!
Congratulations!

And here's the stone.

I wish you luck in restoring the Eternal Crown.
[ES] ¡Claro que sí!
¡Felicitaciones!

Y aquí tienes la piedra.

Te deseo suerte en la restauración de la Eternal Crown.

[EN] Did you get the stone?"Two down, four to go."
[ES] ¿Conseguiste la piedra?"Two down, four to go."

[EN] We're on the right track.

Take this. It should help you retrieving the other stones.
I'll let you know when I have more information.
May the goddess be with you.
[ES] Vamos por buen camino.

Toma esto. Debería ayudarte a recuperar las demás piedras.
Te avisaré cuando tenga más información.
Que la diosa te acompañe.
